newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 826 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 826 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 826 contracts compared with 1,308 overnight Sunday.
There were 66 wheat, 446 corn, 272 soybean, 30 soymeal, two soyoil, two oat, five wheat calls and three corn puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was one cent lower to 2-1/4 cents higher, corn was steady to 1-1/4 cents higher and soybeans were steady to two cents lower.
